expectations.text: Activity: escalation has its own timeline — portents advance whether the party is present or not
expectations.evidence: Line 60: 'the night after the party's arrival at any new port, the Dead Lady manifests.' Escalation is entirely party-triggered. No independent timeline.

expectations.text: Early arrival produces different situation than mid or late arrival
expectations.evidence: Same situation regardless of timing. The Dead Lady manifests the same way at every port.

expectations.text: Tide driven by Umberlee's established want and constraints, not by party arrival
expectations.evidence: Umberlee's want is established but escalation is mechanically tied to party port arrivals. No independent divine timeline.

expectations.text: Causality: each portent follows from the prior through Umberlee's methods (weather, Dead Lady, Waveservants)
expectations.evidence: Portents progress from taken-whole rumor → Delmar's admission → visible confrontation → Delmar's response. Uses Umberlee's established methods.

expectations.text: Quest frame names incompatible wants, live pressure, and uninterrupted consequence
expectations.evidence: Frame names Umberlee's demand vs Delmar's refusal, Dead Lady as pressure, port consequences if unresolved.

expectations.text: Does not make the Dead Lady appear only upon party arrival at a port
expectations.evidence: Line 60: 'the night after the party's arrival at any new port, the Dead Lady manifests behind them.' Explicit frozen-island implementation.
